'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Tom Schwarz DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Schwarz]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Karakagin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
